objective_pt: Recomendar um filme ou série, descrever o enredo sem spoilers ("It's about...", "It's set in...") e dar opinião com adjetivos como "gripping", "boring" e "overrated".

teacher.goal_pt: Aquecer falando do que a pessoa anda assistindo.
prompts: What are you watching at the moment?
Do you prefer movies or series? Why?
watchFor: Dizer "I'm assisting a series"; "assist" é ajudar. Assistir é "watch".
Usar "serie" no singular; em inglês é "a series" (igual no singular e no plural).

exercises.prompt: Have you watched anything good lately?
accepted: Have you watched anything good lately
Have you seen anything good lately

exercises.instruction_pt: Ouça e diga que você está assistindo a uma série coreana.
exercises.listen: What are you watching these days?
accepted: I'm watching a Korean series
I am watching a Korean series
I'm watching a Korean drama
I'm watching a Korean show
A Korean series
I've been watching a Korean series
I'm into a Korean series right now

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Assist" é ajudar. Assistir a filmes e séries é "watch".
É "a series" (com "s" mesmo no singular) e o adjetivo vem antes: "a Korean series".

exercises.instruction_pt: Como se diz "Eu assisti a esse filme ontem"?
options: I saw to this movie yesterday.
exercises.explanation_pt: Assistir a algo é "watch" (ou "see", para filmes). "Assist" significa ajudar.

teacher.goal_pt: Aprender palavras para descrever e avaliar filmes e séries.
prompts: What's a movie everyone loves but you think is overrated?
watchFor: Dizer "the movie passes in Rome"; o natural é "it's set in Rome".

exercises.example_en: The plot is a bit confusing, but the acting is great.
The series is set in London in the 1960s.
Honestly, I think that movie is overrated.
I binge-watched the whole season in one weekend.

exercises.instruction_pt: Diga em inglês: "O filme se passa em Nova York."
accepted: The movie is set in New York
The film is set in New York
The movie takes place in New York
The film takes place in New York
It's set in New York
It takes place in New York

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Se passa em" não é "passes in". Use "is set in" ou "takes place in".
commonErrors.correction_en: The movie is set in New York.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Para o cenário da história, o natural é "is set in" ou "takes place in".
commonErrors.correction_en: The movie is set in New York.

teacher.goal_pt: Pronunciar "series", "comedy" e "documentary" com a sílaba forte certa.
watchFor: Pronunciar "series" como em português ("séries"); o som é "SÍR-iz".
Colocar a força no fim de "comedy" ("comÉdi"); é "CÓ-me-di".

exercises.prompt: It's my favorite series of all time.
accepted: It's my favorite series of all time
It is my favorite series of all time
It's my favourite series of all time

exercises.instruction_pt: Repita. A força está em CO-medy e docu-MEN-tary.
exercises.prompt: I like comedies more than documentaries.
accepted: I like comedies more than documentaries
I like comedies better than documentaries

exercises.instruction_pt: Onde está a sílaba forte de "documentary"?
exercises.explanation_pt: É do-cu-MEN-ta-ry. Em português a força cai no "tá" de "documentário", por isso a confusão.

teacher.goal_pt: Entender uma recomendação e reagir dando opinião.
prompts: Have you seen it? What did you think?
watchFor: Dizer "I didn't like so much"; falta o objeto: "I didn't like it much".

exercises.instruction_pt: Ouça a opinião e escolha o resumo certo.
exercises.listen: The first season was gripping, but the second one was so slow that I gave up halfway through.
options: Gostou da primeira e desistiu no meio da segunda.
exercises.explanation_pt: "Gripping" = envolvente; "I gave up halfway through" = desisti no meio.

exercises.instruction_pt: Ouça e diga que você viu, mas não gostou muito.
exercises.listen: Have you seen the new Batman movie?
accepted: Yes, but I didn't like it much
Yes, I have, but I didn't like it much
Yeah, but I didn't really like it
Yes, but I didn't like it very much
Yes, I saw it, but I didn't like it much
I have, but I didn't love it
Yes, but it wasn't that good

commonErrors.match: \bdid not like (so|very|that) much\b|\bdid not like much\b
commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Like" precisa de objeto: "I didn't like it much".
commonErrors.correction_en: Yes, but I didn't like it much.
Yes, but it was a bit boring.

exercises.instruction_pt: Ouça e diga, em uma frase, sobre o que é o seu filme favorito (por exemplo, um homem perdido no espaço).
accepted: It's about a man who gets lost in space
It's about a man lost in space
It's about an astronaut who gets stuck on Mars
It's about a family that moves to a new city
It's about a woman who wants to become a singer
It's about two friends who travel around the world
It's about a boy who finds a magic book

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Fala sobre" fica mais natural como "It's about..." para filmes e livros.
commonErrors.correction_en: It's about a man who gets lost in space.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Não use "of" depois de "about": "It's about a man...".
commonErrors.correction_en: It's about a man who gets lost in space.

teacher.goal_pt: Recomendar algo para ver: gênero, cenário, enredo sem spoiler, opinião e para quem é.
prompts: What should I watch this weekend?
What's the worst movie you've ever seen?
watchFor: Contar o final; ensine "I don't want to spoil it, but...".

exercises.instruction_pt: Diga em inglês: "Eu não quero dar spoiler, mas o final é incrível."
accepted: I don't want to spoil it, but the ending is amazing
I don't want to spoil it, but the ending is incredible
I don't want to give anything away, but the ending is amazing
I don't want to spoil anything, but the ending is amazing
No spoilers, but the ending is amazing

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "O final" de um filme é "the ending". "The final" é a final de um campeonato.
commonErrors.correction_en: I don't want to spoil it, but the ending is amazing.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Dar spoiler" é "spoil it" ou "give anything away".
commonErrors.correction_en: I don't want to spoil it, but the ending is amazing.

exercises.instruction_pt: Diga em inglês: "Eu maratonei a temporada inteira em dois dias."
accepted: I binge-watched the whole season in two days
I binge watched the whole season in two days
I binge-watched the entire season in two days
I watched the whole season in two days
I binged the whole season in two days

commonErrors.correction_en: I binge-watched the whole season in two days.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "A temporada inteira" fica natural como "the whole season" ou "the entire season".
commonErrors.correction_en: I binge-watched the whole season in two days.

exercises.instruction_pt: Coloque as palavras na ordem certa.
accepted: You should definitely watch it.

exercises.instruction_pt: Recomende um filme ou série para alguém.
exercises.prompt_en: Recommend a movie or series you love. Why should I watch it?
guidelines_pt: Diga o gênero e onde se passa: "It's a thriller set in...".
Resuma o enredo sem spoiler: "It's about...".
Dê a sua opinião com dois adjetivos e diga para quem é: "If you like..., you'll love it".

prompts: What was the last movie you watched?

exercises.prompt: If you like thrillers, you'll love it.
accepted: If you like thrillers, you'll love it
If you like thrillers, you will love it

exercises.instruction_pt: Diga em inglês: "Eu fiquei entediado no meio do filme."
accepted: I got bored in the middle of the movie
I got bored halfway through the movie
I got bored in the middle of the film
I was bored in the middle of the movie
I got bored halfway through the film

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Para o que você sente, use "bored". "I was boring" quer dizer "eu era chato".
commonErrors.correction_en: I got bored in the middle of the movie.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Ficar" entediado é "get bored", e não "stay bored".
commonErrors.correction_en: I got bored in the middle of the movie.

exercises.instruction_pt: Qual frase descreve um filme cansativo?
exercises.explanation_pt: Coisas que causam tédio são "boring". Pessoas que sentem tédio ficam "bored".

exercises.sentence: The story is set ___ Rio in the 1980s.
accepted: in

commonErrors.correction_en: The story is set in Rio in the 1980s.
